items.title: German police name alleged leaders of GandCrab and REvil ransomware groups
items.raw_content: An elusive hacker who went by the handle “ UNKN ” and ran the early Russian ransomware groups GandCrab and REvil now has a name and a face. Authorities in Germany say 31-year-old Russian Daniil Maksimovich Shchukin headed both cybercrime gangs and helped carry out at least 130 acts of computer sabotage and extortion against victims across the country between 2019 and 2021. Shchukin was named as UNKN (a.k.a. UNKNOWN) in an advisory published by the German Federal Criminal Police (the “Bundeskriminalamt” or BKA for short). The BKA said Shchukin and another Russian — 43-year-old Anatoly Sergeevitsch Kravchuk — extorted nearly $2 million euros across two dozen cyberattacks that caused more than 35 million euros in total economic damage.
items.title_zh: 德国警方公布 GandCrab 与 REvil 勒索软件团伙疑似头目
items.summary: Germany's Federal Criminal Police (BKA) named 31-year-old Russian Daniil Maksimovich Shchukin, the hacker known as “UNKN”, as the alleged head of the GandCrab and REvil ransomware groups. The BKA said Shchukin helped carry out at least 130 acts of computer sabotage and extortion from 2019 to 2021, and that he and 43-year-old Anatoly Sergeevitsch Kravchuk extorted nearly 2 million euros in two dozen attacks that caused more than 35 million euros in damage.

items.title_zh: MegaTrain：在单块 GPU 上全精度训练 100B+ 参数 LLM
items.summary: MegaTrain is a memory-centric system that keeps model parameters and optimizer states in host CPU memory and treats GPUs as transient compute engines, aiming to train 100B+ parameter LLMs at full precision on a single GPU. It relies on a pipelined double-buffered engine across CUDA streams and on stateless layer templates instead of persistent autograd graphs.

items.title: Optimal Decay Spectra for Linear Recurrences
items.title_zh: 线性循环模型的最优衰减谱
items.summary: The paper traces the weak long-range memory of linear recurrent models to their decay spectra and introduces PoST, an architecture-agnostic framework that enforces geometrically spaced log-decay rates and adapts the spectrum to the actual dependency range. Tested at 180M-440M scale on Mamba-2, RWKV-7, RetNet, Gated DeltaNet and Gated Linear Attention, it reports zero-shot language-modeling improvements and stronger long-context retrieval for Mamba-2.

items.title: VSAS-Bench: Real-Time Evaluation of Visual Streaming Assistant Models
items.title_zh: VSAS-Bench：视觉流式助手模型的实时评测基准
items.summary: Apple researchers propose VSAS-Bench, a benchmark for visual streaming assistants built on more than 18,000 temporally dense annotations, with synchronous and asynchronous protocols that also measure proactiveness and consistency. They report that ordinary VLMs can be adapted to streaming without extra training and can outperform dedicated streaming models, with Qwen3-VL-4B beating Dispider by 3% under the asynchronous protocol.

items.title: The xPU-athalon: Quantifying the Competition of AI Acceleration
items.title_zh: xPU 大竞技：量化 AI 加速器的竞争
items.summary: The paper benchmarks AI accelerators — Cerebras CS-3, SambaNova SN-40, Groq, Gaudi and TPUv5e — against NVIDIA A100/H100 and AMD MI-300X GPUs on latency, throughput, power and energy efficiency. It finds the best platform varies with batch size, sequence length and model size, and that Cerebras, SambaNova and Gaudi draw 10–60% more idle power than NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

items.title: Coverage Optimization for Camera View Selection
items.title_zh: 相机视角选择中的覆盖优化
items.summary: The authors introduce COVER, a lightweight coverage-based metric for active camera view selection that approximates Fisher Information Gain and avoids expensive transmittance estimation. Integrated into Nerfstudio, it improved reconstruction quality over state-of-the-art active view selection methods across real datasets in fixed and embodied settings.

items.title: A Statistical Framework for Auditing Behavioral Dependence and Induced Bias in LLM Judges
items.title_zh: 审计 LLM 评判器行为依赖与诱导偏差的统计框架
items.summary: The authors introduce a statistical framework for auditing hidden behavioral entanglement among black-box LLMs, which can arise from shared pretraining data, distillation or alignment and undermine LLM-as-a-judge and ensemble verification setups that assume independent signals. Across 18 models from six families they find significant entanglement associated with judge over-endorsement bias, and show that de-entangled verifier reweighting beats majority voting in accuracy and precision.

items.title: R2G: A Multi-View Circuit Graph Benchmark Suite from RTL to GDSII
items.title_zh: R2G：从 RTL 到 GDSII 的多视图电路图基准套件
items.summary: R2G standardizes five stage-aware circuit-graph views with information parity across 30 open-source IP cores and supplies an end-to-end DEF-to-graph pipeline, loaders, splits and baselines. In studies with GINE, GAT and ResGatedGCN, the authors find that view choice dominates model choice, with Test R² varying by more than 0.3 for a fixed GNN.

items.title: Battery health prognosis using Physics-informed neural network with Quantum Feature mapping
items.title_zh: 基于量子特征映射物理信息神经网络的电池健康预测
items.summary: The paper proposes QPINN, a physics-informed neural network with quantum feature mapping that projects battery sensor data into a high-dimensional Hilbert space using the Nyström method. It reports 99.46% average state-of-health accuracy and validated cross-chemistry transfer on a dataset of 310,705 samples from 387 cells.

items.title: Transformers Learn Latent Mixture Models In-Context via Mirror Descent
items.title_zh: Transformer 借镜像下降在上下文中学习潜在混合模型
items.summary: The paper frames token-importance estimation as in-context learning under a Mixture of Transition Distributions, with a latent variable setting how much past tokens influence the next. It shows transformers can implement Mirror Descent to learn the mixture weights, giving an explicit three-layer construction that is a first-order approximation of the Bayes-optimal predictor.
